subject: Implement /approve and /deny slash command parser (pre-agent)
description:
In `capo/transport/dispatcher.py`, before approval-id detection and before `agent.run`: parse `/approve <approval_id>` and `/deny <approval_id>` as unambiguous approval shortcuts. Same effect as a labeled-option reply: call `DBOS.send(approval_id, choice)` and mark read.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `/approve <id>` and `/deny <id>` parsed before agent loop.
- [ ] Match is case-insensitive on the keyword, exact on the id.
- [ ] If id doesn't match a `pending` approval: reply with "approval id <id> not found or already resolved".
- [ ] Slash command consumes ZERO tokens (no agent.run).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Whitespace before/after id tolerated.
- [ ] User combines text + slash command: treat as slash command (text ignored for resolution).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: parser matches `/approve <id>`, `/deny <id>`, both case-insensitively
• Integration: `/approve <id>` resolves the approval workflow

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.8, 5.10, 9.4
